skills.name: city-miniature
skills.description: Build an interactive 3D miniature of a city from scratch as one offline HTML file — city-specific geography, landmarks, traffic, day/night and bilingual UI. Existing miniatures are mechanism references only, never templates to reskin.

skills.name: session-export
skills.description: Export OpenCode session transcripts to Markdown with a maintained table of contents and a JSON index, sanitized so credentials and personal data never reach the archive.

skills.name: session-to-skill
skills.description: Turn a finished session or project into a reusable OpenCode skill — extract the working artifact as a template, write the instructions and references, and prove it by scaffolding a fresh project from it.

skills.name: skill-publish
skills.description: Publish an OpenCode skill to GitHub — validate it, lay it out as skills/<id>/, write the handoff and attribution notes, and serve it through an HTTP catalog with GitHub Pages.

skills.name: khan-trig-studio
skills.description: Build a bilingual, offline, canvas-based Khan Trig Companion studio with three interactive modules, exact math, practice persistence, headless checks and a GitHub Pages release.

skills.name: cinematic-3d-release
skills.description: Add cinematic camera choreography, step-by-step playback, and release-grade documentation to a static Three.js app, then verify and publish it.
